Jharkhand Teacher Eligibility Test JHTET Admit Card Date 2026 – Full Details

Short Details : Jharkhand Academic Council (JAC) has released the Admit Card Date for the Jharkhand Teacher Eligibility Test (JHTET) 2026. Applications for the Jharkhand Teacher Eligibility Test JHTET Online Form 2026 were accepted from 21 April 2026, to 20 July 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 01 November 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Jharkhand Teacher Eligibility Test JHTET Admit Card from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 April 2026
  • Last Date : 20 July 2026 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 June 2026
  • Exam Date : 01 November 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 15 October 2026
  • Candidates must go to the Important Links section below
  • Then the candidates must click on the Admit Card link.
  • After clicking on the link, the candidates will be redirected to a new page.
  • In this page, candidates have to enter the following details:
  • Registration no.
  • Login ID
  • Birth Date/Password
  • Captcha Code
  • Then the candidates have to submit the details by clicking on the Login button.

Application Fee

  • Fees For Paper I or Paper II Only
  • General, EWS, BC : Rs. 1300/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 700/-
  • Fees For Both Paper
  • General, BC, EWS : Rs. 1500/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 800/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Jharkhand Teacher Eligibility Test JHTET Admit Card Date 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.
